1: // Simple endless runner based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   // Audio context for sound effects
7:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
8:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
9:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
10:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
11:     osc.type = 'sine';
12:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
13:     osc.connect(gain);
14:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
15:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
16:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
17:     osc.start();
18:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
19:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
20:   }
21:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
22:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
23: 
24:   // Resize canvas to fill window
25:   function resize() {
26:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
27:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
28:   }
29:   resize();
30:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
31: 
32:   // Game state
33:   let running = false;
34:   let gameOver = false;
35:   let score = 0;
36:   const speed = 5; // world scroll speed (px/frame)
37: 
38:   // Player definition
39:   const player = {
40:     width: 40,
41:     height: 40,
42:     x: canvas.width * 0.2,
43:     y: canvas.height - 60,
44:     vy: 0,
45:     jumpStrength: -12,
46:     gravity: 0.5,
47:     lane: 0, // -1 left, 0 center, 1 right
48:     laneOffset: 60,
49:   };
50: 
51:   function resetPlayer() {
52:     player.x = canvas.width * 0.2;
53:     player.y = canvas.height - 60;
54:     player.vy = 0;
55:     player.lane = 0;
56:   }
57: 
58:   // Obstacles, particles, and road
59:   const obstacles = [];
60:   const particles = [];
61:   const obstacleFreq = 120; // frames between obstacles
62:   let obstacleTimer = 0;
63:   let roadOffset = 0; // offset for moving lane marker
64: 
65:   function spawnObstacle() {
66:     const lane = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3) - 1; // -1,0,1
67:     const size = 40;
68:     const y = canvas.height - 60;
69:     const x = canvas.width + size;
70:     const offsetX = lane * player.laneOffset;
71:     const obs = { x: x + offsetX, y: y - size, width: size, height: size, lane };
72:     obstacles.push(obs);
73:     // create spark particles at obstacle location
74:     for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
75:       particles.push({
76:         x: obs.x + size / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10,
77:         y: obs.y - size / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10,
78:         vy: - (1 + Math.random() * 1),
79:         alpha: 1,
80:         size: 2 + Math.random() * 2,
81:         color: '#0ff'
82:       });
83:     }
84:   }
85: 
86:   // Input handling
87:   function handleJump() {
88:     if (!running) return;
89:     if (player.vy === 0) {
90:       player.vy = player.jumpStrength;
91:       // play jump sound
92:       playTone(300, 0.1);
93:     }
94:   }
95:   function handleLaneChange(dir) {
96:     if (!running) return;
97:     const newLane = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, player.lane + dir));
98:     if (newLane !== player.lane) {
99:       player.lane = newLane;
100:       player.x = canvas.width * 0.2 + player.lane * player.laneOffset;
101:     }
102:   }
103: 
104:   document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
105:     if (e.code === 'Space') handleJump();
106:     if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft') handleLaneChange(-1);
107:     if (e.code === 'ArrowRight') handleLaneChange(1);
108:     if (e.code === 'Enter' && gameOver) start();
109:   });
110:   document.addEventListener('click', () => {
111:     if (!running) return handleJump();
112:     if (gameOver) start();
113:   });
114: 
115:   // Collision detection
116:   function collides(a, b) {
117:     return a.x < b.x + b.width && a.x + a.width > b.x &&
118:            a.y < b.y + b.height && a.y + a.height > b.y;
119:   }
120: 
121:   // Game loop
122:   function update() {
123:     if (!running) return;
124:     // player physics
125:     player.vy += player.gravity;
126:     player.y += player.vy;
127:     if (player.y > canvas.height - 60) {
128:       player.y = canvas.height - 60;
129:       player.vy = 0;
130:     }
131:     // obstacles movement
132:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
133:       const obs = obstacles[i];
134:       obs.x -= speed;
135:       if (obs.x + obs.width < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
136:       else if (collides(player, obs)) {
137:         running = false;
138:         gameOver = true;
139:         // play collision sound
140:         playTone(100, 0.3);
141:       }
142:     }
143:     // particles update
144:     for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
145:       const p = particles[i];
146:       p.vy += 0.05; // gravity for sparks
147:       p.y += p.vy;
148:       p.x += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5; // small drift
149:       p.alpha -= 0.02;
150:       if (p.alpha <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
151:     }
152:     // road scrolling offset
153:     roadOffset = (roadOffset + speed) % 80;
154:     // spawn obstacles
155:     if (obstacleTimer <= 0) {
156:       spawnObstacle();
157:       obstacleTimer = obstacleFreq;
158:     } else {
159:       obstacleTimer--;
160:     }
161:     // score increments by distance travelled
162:     score += speed * 0.01;
163:   }
164: 
165:   function draw() {
166:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
167:     // background – moving neon gradient
168:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
169:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
170:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#004');
171:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
172:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
173:     // subtle vertical lines for cityscape feel
174:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,255,255,0.05)';
175:     ctx.lineWidth = 1;
176:     for (let x = 0; x < canvas.width; x += 40) {
177:       ctx.beginPath();
178:       ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
179:       ctx.lineTo(x, canvas.height);
180:       ctx.stroke();
181:     }
182:     // moving road lane markers
183:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,255,255,0.3)';
184:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
185:     for (let y = canvas.height - 20; y > canvas.height - 120; y -= 80) {
186:       ctx.beginPath();
187:       ctx.moveTo(-roadOffset, y);
188:       ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, y);
189:       ctx.stroke();
190:     }
191:     // player – neon hovercraft
192:     ctx.save();
193:     ctx.shadowColor = '#0ff';
194:     ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
195:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
196:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y - player.height, player.width, player.height);
197:     ctx.restore();
198:   // obstacles – neon blocks
199:   ctx.save();
200:   ctx.shadowColor = '#f00';
201:   ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
202:   ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
203:   for (const o of obstacles) {
204:     ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y - o.height, o.width, o.height);
205:   }
206:   ctx.restore();
207:   // particles – glowing sparks
208:   ctx.save();
209:   for (const p of particles) {
210:     ctx.globalAlpha = p.alpha;
211:     ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
212:     ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.size, p.size);
213:   }
214:   ctx.restore();
215:     // score
216:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
217:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
218:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}`, 20, 30);
219:     // Game over overlay
220:     if (gameOver) {
221:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
222:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
223:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
224:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
225:       ctx.font = '40px sans-serif';
226:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
227:       ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
228:       ctx.fillText('Press Enter or Click to Restart', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 20);
229:     }
230:   }
231: 
232:   function loop() {
233:     update();
234:     draw();
235:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
236:   }
237: 
238:   function start() {
239:     resetPlayer();
240:     obstacles.length = 0;
241:     obstacleTimer = 0;
242:     score = 0;
243:     gameOver = false;
244:     running = true;
245:   }
246: 
247:   // start automatically
248:   start();
249:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
250: })();
